fichas.title: Cinema projection and auditorium
fichas.summary: Design guidance for cinema projection rooms, picture formats, screens, and auditoriums. Projection rooms require equipment-company consultation, equipment clearances, ventilation and extraction, and sound insulation. Auditorium guidance addresses sightlines, lighting, acoustics, and screen placement.
uses: Controlling projection, hall lighting, stage lighting, and curtains
